reference: The otter has nudged my sleeve three times already this morning.
sk: Vydra ma dnes ráno šťuchla do rukáva už trikrát.
cz: Vydra mě dnes ráno šťouchla do rukávu už třikrát.
acceptable: The otter has {nudged|poked|prodded} my sleeve already three times this morning.
The otter has already {nudged|poked|prodded} my sleeve three times this morning.
The otter has {nudged|poked|prodded} my sleeve three times this morning already.
This morning the otter has already {nudged|poked|prodded} my sleeve three times.
This morning the otter has {nudged|poked|prodded} my sleeve three times already.

mistakes.text: The otter {nudged|poked} my sleeve three times already this morning.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Obdobie „this morning“ ešte neskončilo, preto je lepší Present Perfect: „has nudged“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Období „this morning“ ještě neskončilo, proto je lepší Present Perfect: „has nudged“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “this morning” is not over yet, so Present Perfect is better: “has nudged”.

mistakes.text: The otter has been {nudging|poking} my sleeve three times already this morning.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri počte hotových dejov („three times“) patrí Present Perfect Simple: „has nudged“, nie „has been nudging“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U počtu hotových dějů („three times“) patří Present Perfect Simple: „has nudged“, ne „has been nudging“.
mistakes.feedback_en: When you count finished actions (“three times”), use Present Perfect Simple: “has nudged”, not “has been nudging”.

mistakes.text: The otter has {nudged|poked} me {into|to|in} the sleeve three times already this morning.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po anglicky sa šťuchne do rukáva priamo: „nudged my sleeve“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Anglicky se šťouchá do rukávu přímo: „nudged my sleeve“.
mistakes.feedback_en: In English the sleeve is the direct object: “nudged my sleeve”.

mistakes.text: The otter has {nudged|poked} my sleeve three times already today morning.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Dnes ráno“ je po anglicky „this morning“, nie „today morning“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Dnes ráno“ je anglicky „this morning“, ne „today morning“.
